scope: Independent frozen-source review and 26 offline tests. Counterexamples use only copied synthetic files and mocked subprocess/audit results; no PostgreSQL, provider, Docker, service or real CLI invocation.

remaining_findings.problem: The batch consistency gate compares only seal, registration and deployment_binding. It accepts changed top-level total_budget_microusd, allocated_total_microusd, corpus_sha256 and task_order, then reports the substituted budget fields.

minimal_reproduction.scope: Synthetic saved batch and mocked no-network preflight; no task submitted.

remaining_findings.recommendation: Validate the exact batch envelope: fixed corpus hash and task order, authorized registration total and allocation sum, full binding, valid creation timestamp, and supported field set. Derive report cap fields from validated registration/binding, not unverified redundant batch fields.

remaining_findings.problem: A saved submission run_id is audited for tenant/run but never bound to the case project or submission intent. A successful other-project run with identical provider/model/prices/cap can be counted as a verified repair of this case.

minimal_reproduction.scope: Synthetic CLI/ledger/artifacts. No process, socket, provider or PostgreSQL invocation. The mismatching run/project is intentionally not rejected by frozen collector.

remaining_findings.recommendation: Before collection verify project.json and submission-intent/submission/CLI identity consistency, and bind GET/SQL project/run/input evidence to the expected fixed case/source/profile/task. Reject duplicate run IDs across batch cases. Preserve raw evidence and stop on mismatch rather than crediting a repair.

unconfirmed_hypothesis.schema_usage_preflight: Table SELECT ACL proof does not explicitly test schema USAGE. However the text relation-name resolution inside has_table_privilege may already reject missing schema USAGE. Do not count this as a confirmed P2 without a real isolated PostgreSQL negative. Root has been informed of this uncertainty.

accepted_boundaries: Descriptor strict fields/types/duplicate detection pin one model/budget/corpus/bundle/CLI/API/tenant/schema/OID/audit role and one exclusive output path; no isolated fallback to public or another CLI on validation failure.
Audit SQL qualifies all business tables with psql quoted schema identifiers and uses read-only transactions plus pg_catalog search path. Scope is rechecked on preflight and each run audit.

Isolated CLI environment contains only three explicit client values and minimal process fields; audit process receives only its own exact connection fields. Provider keys and inherited PG service/options are not forwarded.
Missing/duplicate/orphan reservation identity and invalid reserved/settled costs fail rather than silently becoming zero. Failed task auditing remains in aggregate committed allocation exposure.
limits: Offline SQL outputs are mocked. No PostgreSQL syntax, RLS/ACL/OID or actual API/worker deployment proof is claimed.
Descriptor and clean binary hash are local operator evidence, not attestation of which actual worker configuration loaded; external deployment attestation remains required.
Fixed output prevents accidental duplicate batches for an intact descriptor, not a lifetime provider entitlement.

The source worktree was switched by another agent after the completed 26-test before/after check. New counterexamples therefore run the frozen copied source; first missing-module wrapper failure is unrelated to collector behavior.
